Biometric Notification
  

Biometric Aadhaar Authentication is required for Aadhaar linking in case of Demographic Data mismatch in PAN and Aadhaar. Please visit your nearest designated PAN center for Biometric Aadhaar Authentication.  
  
For more information on biometric centers visit ([PAN Application Centers](https://www.psaonline.utiitsl.com/PanPSACenters/forms/applicationCenters)).
